scope: Two directly evaluated energy-cell midpoints at the peak-temperature shell; retained as an immutable historical pilot, not global P1-B acceptance.
interpretation: The original five-knot energy grid has 14.18% and 15.15% log-linear midpoint discrepancies in the first two intervals. The 20-to-24 order changes independently reproduced here are 0.02958% and 0.02456%. The expanded one-bisection PCHIP anchor audit is recorded in the superseding summary.
acceptance: This two-cell pilot is not an acceptance result. No full-star emissivity or optical-depth calculation is included.
